title: 万斯：伊朗协议是美国权力平衡的“双赢”
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The part of the peace plan, the part of this MOU that I think have been most misrepresented by certain parts of the media is the idea that the Iranians get
segments.zh: 和平计划中，部分媒体最曲解的一点是，伊朗能获得所有好处。

segments.en: all these benefits. You will hear things about $300 billion or $24 billion.
segments.zh: 你会听到3000亿或240亿美元的说法。

segments.en: Or this for that number of money or amount of money. And the simple fact is that the only way the Iranians get any of those resources, not a single penny by the way
segments.zh: 但事实是，伊朗要拿到任何资金——注意，美国一分钱都不会出——

segments.en: from the United States of America, under any circumstances.
segments.zh: 在任何情况下，美国都不会给伊朗一分钱。

segments.en: But the only way that they would ever get any benefit of the bargain is if they comply fully and change their behavior. And so you really have a win-win situation
segments.zh: 他们获得好处的唯一途径是全面履约并改变行为。所以这对美国是双赢。

segments.en: for the United States of America. If the Iranians don't change their behavior, their military and their nuclear program is still destroyed.
segments.zh: 如果伊朗不改变，他们的军事和核计划仍被摧毁。

segments.en: If they do change their behavior, then they are going to have a transformative relationship with the Middle East and the Middle East will have a transformative
segments.zh: 如果他们改变，就能与中东建立变革性关系，中东也能与伊朗人民建立变革性关系。

segments.en: relationship with the people of Iran. That's a win for the American people and for the President of the United States, regardless of which option the
segments.zh: 无论伊朗最终选择哪条路，这对美国人民和总统都是胜利。
